description.narrative: These Task Force programs are designed to engage participants in a practical dialogue about the realities on the ground and opportunities to leverage existing resources, communities and governments to reduce the impact of the long-standing conflict and look towards the future. The programs are intended to be highly interactive with a free-flowing open discussion. All invited participants come prepared to discuss the series of related topics and think in terms of the social and institutional changes that must take priority to ensure success specifically pressing issues; priorities that need to be addressed; and prospects for the immediate and mid-term future. The basic question to be examined: What do these countries want their nations to be and what are the next steps moving ahead? The meeting will be held under Chatham House Rule, by-name CMED invitation only.
